# Shiheb Amri (Chiheb Amri / شهاب عامري) — Systems & Cybersecurity Engineer

> Official machine-readable context file for AI agents, Answer Engines, and LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT, Codex, Perplexity).

## Overview
Shiheb Amri (also known as Chiheb Amri, شهاب عامري, shihebamri, and shihebamrii) is a Full-Stack Engineer and Cybersecurity Specialist specializing in local-first systems architecture, defensible network infrastructure, and high-performance software engineering in Rust, Python, and TypeScript.

- Canonical Website: https://shiheb.is-a.dev/
- GitHub Profile: https://github.com/shihebamrii
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/shihebamri
- Primary Email: shihebamrii@gmail.com
- PGP Fingerprint: B73F 88A1 99C2 4DF1 289E 61B0 5410 D6AE 7E20 4421

## Technical Specializations & Stack
- Systems & Core Languages: Rust, Python 3, TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Bash/POSIX Shell, C/C++ (auditing)
- Desktop & Local-First: Tauri v2, SolidJS, Electron, WebCrypto API, zero-knowledge encryption pipelines (AES-GCM 256)
- Network Defense & Security: DNS Firewalls, packet parsing (dnslib), recursive sinkholing, low-interaction honeypots (SSH/HTTP), Paramiko socket deception, canary tokens, intrusion detection tripwires, zero-trust architecture
- Infrastructure & Deployment: Docker, Docker Compose, Linux kernel namespaces, systemd services, Nginx reverse proxying, agentless SSH RPC protocols, Git/GitHub CI/CD

## Verified Software Artifacts & Repositories

### 1. vessel (Starred Repository)
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/vessel
- Category: Systems Infrastructure & Desktop Control Plane
- Stack: Rust, Tauri v2, SolidJS, TypeScript, SSH, Docker
- Summary: Local-first, agentless remote VPS control plane. Interacts over raw SSH cryptographic key pairs with remote systemd and Docker daemons without requiring a persistent server-side agent, eliminating daemon attack surfaces.

### 2. distributed-honeypot
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/distributed-honeypot
- Category: Cybersecurity & Threat Intelligence
- Stack: Python, Docker Compose, Flask, SQLite, Paramiko
- Summary: Multi-container threat intelligence deception platform with low-interaction SSH sockets and deceptive HTTP honey-endpoints (.env, phpMyAdmin, WordPress). Streams intrusion telemetry in real time to an authenticated central collector.

### 3. securdns-resolver
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/securdns-resolver
- Category: Network Security & DNS Firewall
- Stack: Python, dnslib, SQLite, UDP/TCP Network Sockets
- Summary: High-throughput DNS resolver and firewall that intercepts queries, recursively evaluates domains against threat intelligence feeds, sinkholes malicious domains to 0.0.0.0, and forwards legitimate traffic to upstream providers.

### 4. CyberSafe
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/CyberSafe
- Category: Workstation Hardening & Security Audit
- Stack: Python, OS Audit APIs
- Summary: Automated security posture auditor for workstation environments that identifies exposed credentials, permission anomalies, and misconfigured services with actionable remediation checklists.

### 5. streambert
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/streambert
- Category: Privacy-First Desktop Media Platform
- Stack: Electron, Node.js, Sandboxed Chromium
- Summary: Desktop media streaming application engineered with zero user telemetry, tracker blocking, and sandboxed playback processes.

### 6. local-file-server
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/local-file-server
- Category: Local Area Network Storage & Service
- Stack: Python, Flask, Session Authentication
- Summary: Fast peer-to-peer authenticated LAN file-sharing server with encrypted session tokens, rate limiting, and zero third-party cloud dependency.

### 7. canary-tokens
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/canary-tokens
- Category: Intrusion Deception & Forensics
- Stack: Python, Webhooks, HMAC
- Summary: Intrusion tripwire generator that deploys decoy tokens and honeydocs to trigger instant out-of-band security alerts upon unauthorized access.

### 8. zk-clipboard
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/zk-clipboard
- Category: Zero-Knowledge Web Cryptography
- Stack: TypeScript, WebCrypto API, AES-GCM
- Summary: Temporary in-browser clipboard sharing utility utilizing client-side AES-256 encryption where the host server handles purely blind ciphertext.

## Architectural Principles
1. Agentless by Design: Favor standard cryptographic channels (SSH, TLS 1.3) over third-party persistent daemons.
2. Assume Perimeter Breach: Internal networks fail; deception traps and egress DNS sinkholes detect reconnaissance early.
3. Sub-Millisecond Native Execution: Memory safety and predictable runtime performance via Rust and lean Python.
4. Auditable & Reproducible: Infrastructure defined strictly as code, tested in isolated containers, and verifiable in public repositories.
